title: Ethan Marcotte resigned from his job at 18F (a GSA subsidiary) rather...
content: Ethan Marcotte resigned from his job at 18F (a GSA subsidiary) rather than participate in the Trump/Musk purge of gov’t employees. “I didn’t want to sit down with anyone involved in that, and pretend like any part of their work was lawful, legitimate, or moral.”
author: Jason Kottke
